newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Steady U.S.rates lift Manila shares at close.
newsitem.headline: Steady U.S.rates lift Manila shares at close.

text.p: * But turnover unimpressive at 1.5 billion pesos

Philippine shares snapped out of a four-day losing streak on Wednesday propped up by the U.S. maintaining interest rates and higher agricultural growth for the first quarter of the year, traders said.

"The Fed's decision was the obvious factor and agricultural growth sends a good signal that one fourth of the GNP component is okay," said Wilfred Son Keng Po, chief operating officer at Angping & Associates.
